rule: A verified signal may contribute to one or more earned outputs. Each output must have a distinct reader job, exact evidence/version binding and explicit routing decision; the signal is never copied across formats merely to fill space.

explanationMethod.hannahFryMethod: Begin with the reader's human reason, make the invisible mechanism concrete, move from familiar experience to technical truth and back, preserve consequences and land with a better question or useful action.
explanationMethod.feynmanStyleMethod: Reconstruct from first principles in ordinary words, explain every causal link, expose false understanding with explain-back and test transfer on a genuinely different case.
explanationMethod.aidbScrutinyMethod: After an independent primary-source read, separate the circulating headline from what happened, what the evidence establishes and does not establish, the claimed impact, the real consequence and unresolved questions; compare AIDB or record a dated honest absence.
explanationMethod.nonImitationBoundary: Use the explanatory and editorial methods without imitating Hannah Fry's or Richard Feynman's voice, persona or wording and without copying or deferring to AIDB; the finished prose must remain recognizably LAiDIES.
requiredProducerEvidence: human reader question and necessary background
plain-language causal mechanism with no unexplained links
AIDB comparison or dated honest absence after the independent read
explain-back test that cannot be passed by parroting
one workplace example and one non-work or everyday-life example that preserve the same mechanism in genuinely different settings
bounded useful action, decision rule or better next question
explanationMethod.failureRule: Missing any lens or merely naming Hannah Fry, Feynman or AIDB fails production; structural presence cannot admit prose quality.

multiOutputContract.example: One current event may qualify for The Breaking or The Daily and also become contributing evidence inside a broader The Big Question.
multiOutputContract.independenceRule: Each resulting output has its own reader payoff, producer contract, review, correction state and release identity. One output cannot inherit admission from another.

dailyServiceColumnClarityContract.rule: A cold reader must identify each column's distinct job from headline and body without relying on its eyebrow label.
dailyServiceColumnClarityContract.paige: One obvious, followable AI action the reader can use and check today.
dailyServiceColumnClarityContract.careerWorkLife: A recognizable career or work-life situation and useful career guidance first; an AI connection follows only when it materially improves understanding or action.
dailyServiceColumnClarityContract.promptoscope: One accurate prompt, context or model-use habit taught through one concrete example and made memorable through a playful horoscope frame. Name what the reader changes, keeps, compares and does next. Do not force a work/home pair into the compact card.
dailyServiceColumnClarityContract.review: Present one candidate and one decision at a time. Repeated controls or neighbouring columns may appear only when explicitly labelled inside the artifact, visually isolated and necessary to the decision.
